story.artifact_power: Ancient frozen power atop the highest peak.
story.greeting: Romy, your island mission begins now — listen closely.
story.act1: On Snowy Peaks Island, jagged mountains rise through endless blizzards, where a towering yeti-monkey Viking roams the frozen ridges. Wielding an icy axe and driven by the will of Doctor Krit, it raids anything that dares cross its path. At the highest peak lies the Frost Core, pulsing with ancient power. Romy, we must reach it, shatter its influence, and free the yeti monkey from Krit's control before the storm swallows the island whole.
story.act2: A bumbling yeti-monkey Viking is causing a chilly mess! He accidentally carved symbols into the ice, turning them into slippery fraction puzzles. As he stomps around, fractions are mislabelled on every icy surface.
story.act3: Your mission, Romy, is to solve these frosty fraction puzzles and bring order back to the island. The Frost Bracelet, a treasure of boundless ice control, awaits.
story.goal: Romy, master every math trial, reach the island's core in time, and break Doctor Krit's hold.

rule.text: Count ALL the equal parts for the bottom number, and only the shaded parts for the top. 3 shaded of 8 = 3/8.

tutor_notes.block1_script: Guide Romy through a journey of fractions, emphasizing the magic of numerals shading icy shapes.
tutor_notes.block2_hint: Keep a steady pace; each challenge builds on the last, offering Romy a path to mastering fractions.
block3_tips: Allow Romy to visualize and manipulate visuals to better grasp fractions.
Encourage quick decisions in timer challenges to build confidence.
tutor_notes.block5_abstraction: Link fractions to everyday vision, seeing parts as proportions of larger dreams.
tutor_notes.weak_point_focus: Pay close attention to understanding fraction labels versus actual shaded parts.
